optimizedDescription.value: `buildProjectStatusSnapshot` merges GetProjectSummary (optional changes/specs health) and graph health via SdkHostContext; null on graph fail.

optimizedContext.value:
# Build Project Status Snapshot

## Rules
### buildProjectStatusSnapshot orchestration
- `buildProjectStatusSnapshot(ctx: SdkHostContext, options?: BuildProjectStatusSnapshotOptions): Promise<BuildProjectStatusSnapshotResult>`
  1. `ctx.kernel.project.getProjectSummary.execute(summaryInput)`: workspace counts, change/draft/discarded/archive totals, spec counts per workspace. `summaryInput` from options:
     - `includeChanges` when `options.includeChanges` is `true`
     - `includeSpecsHealth` when `options.includeSpecsHealth` is `true`
     - both omitted/false → `execute()` / `execute({})` (count-only)
  2. `options.includeGraph` `true` (default `false`): `withOpenGraphProvider(ctx, async (provider) => { ... })`, `createGetGraphHealth()` from `@specd/code-graph`, `getGraphHealth.execute({ config, provider, codeGraphVersion, workspaces, assertUnlocked: false })`. `config` = `ctx.kernel.project.getConfig.execute()`. `workspaces` = `ctx.kernel.project.listWorkspaces.execute()`
  3. Merge summary fields + optional `graphHealth` + `hotspots` when graph requested
- Graph fail (provider open, health, hotspots) → `graphHealth: null` and `hotspots: null` when requested; MUST NOT throw
- `includeGraph` `false` → MUST NOT open graph provider

### Result shape stability
- `BuildProjectStatusSnapshotOptions`: `includeGraph?: boolean` (default `false`); `includeHotspots?: boolean`; `includeChanges?: boolean` (default `false`, forwarded to `GetProjectSummary`); `includeSpecsHealth?: boolean` (default `false`, forwarded to `GetProjectSummary`)
- `BuildProjectStatusSnapshotResult`:
  - `summary`: `GetProjectSummaryResult` (optional `active` / `drafts` / `specsHealth` when requested)
  - `graphHealth`: `GetGraphHealthResult | null` (null if not requested or unavailable)
  - `approvals`: `{ specEnabled: boolean; signoffEnabled: boolean }` from `ctx.kernel.project.getConfig.execute()`
  - `llmOptimizedContext`: boolean from config
- Hotspots only if `options.includeHotspots` true and graph loaded; else omit or null
- MUST NOT duplicate enriched listing/health fields outside `summary`; hosts read them from `summary`

### No presenter formatting
- Structured data only. Text/JSON/toon stays in CLI presenters

### No direct repository bootstrap in snapshot orchestration
- Project summary + workspaces ONLY via `SdkHostContext` project queries
- MUST NOT construct `ChangeRepository` or `SpecRepository`
- MUST NOT recreate parallel/partial repository bootstrap outside canonical composition-backed read flow

## Constraints
- Single cross-package read path in `@specd/sdk` for `project status --graph` and API hosts
- Hosts treat null graph as unavailable graph data
